name: weather-conditions-simple
description: WEATHER-CONDITIONS simple rung. The Scene menu's Weather picker exists in SIMPLE mode (the flag is simple-tier and now defaults on), selecting a condition writes the store, and the render actually responds: one orbit frame per condition plus a probe that reads the live lighting back off the scene graph. The probe is the load-bearing part — a screenshot cannot tell a grade that ran from one that was computed and discarded, and the sun intensity going to EXACTLY 0 under a deck is the single clearest signature that it ran. Also censuses the live WebGL program count before and after the four weather changes: three bakes the point/spot light COUNT into every lit material's cache key, and a +-1 change recompiles every one of them (measured 204-214 ms, +29 programs, LIGHT-COUNT-STABLE). The grade sets the sun's intensity to 0 rather than unmounting the light, so the count must not move -- and a program census is the only thing that can show it.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: probe-clear
steps.eval: (() => { const { scene } = window.__three; let sun = null, hemi = null, amb = null; scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isDirectionalLight && o.castShadow && sun === null) sun = o; if (o.isHemisphereLight) hemi = o; if (o.isAmbientLight) amb = o }); console.log('[probe] weather clear ' + JSON.stringify({ weather: window.__store.getState().weather, sun: +sun.intensity.toFixed(4), hemi: +hemi.intensity.toFixed(4), ambient: +amb.intensity.toFixed(4), env: +scene.environmentIntensity.toFixed(4), skyB: +hemi.color.b.toFixed(4) })) })()

steps.name: probe-programs-clear
steps.eval: (() => { const gl = window.__three.gl; const info = gl.info; const programs = (gl.info.programs ? gl.info.programs.length : -1); console.log('[probe] programs '+JSON.stringify({ at: window.__store.getState().weather, programs, geometries: info.memory.geometries, textures: info.memory.textures, calls: info.render.calls })) })()
